facts.L2_tax_id: Personnummer, or a co-ordination number if you're not in the population register.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed: about 32% municipal, plus 20% national above SEK 643,000.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 25% VAT; exempt while turnover stays under SEK 120,000 a year.
